name: Deploy Dry Run
description: Runs a deployment dry-run before actual deploy commands to catch configuration errors and preview what would be deployed
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run deploy dry-run before actual deployment
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
# Detect deploy commands (skip if already a dry-run)
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(deploy|publish)' && ! echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qiE '(dry-run|--dry|preview)'; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  # Vercel
  if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q 'vercel deploy'; then
    echo "Running Vercel deploy preview first..."
    cd "$ROOT" && vercel --dry-run 2>/dev/null | tail -5
  fi
  # Firebase
  if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q 'firebase deploy'; then
    echo "Running Firebase deploy dry-run..."
    cd "$ROOT" && firebase deploy --only hosting --dry-run 2>/dev/null | tail -5
  fi
  # npm publish
  if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q 'npm publish'; then
    echo "Running npm publish dry-run..."
    cd "$ROOT" && npm publish --dry-run 2>/dev/null | tail -10
  fi
fi
exit 0
